name: Yuumi Natsuki
source:
An underclassman that's one grade lower than the protagonist.
He is cute enough that he has a secret fanclub, but he has a sharp tongue and cheeky personality.
He's a bit overwhelmingly sarcastic towards the protagonist, but he says there is love in it.
